protocol: astra-conv-04 acceptance: re-review the frozen revision using B/N labels; verdict revise only with >=1 B finding; N findings are backlog
b_n_policy: B = a finding that blocks accept for that target. N = backlog; does not block. A verdict is revise only if >=1 B finding is recorded for that target. Gate-level blockers that are not defects of the reviewed artifact are listed separately in open_gate_blockers and are NOT counted as B.
